notes:
V3.1.2 — version-bug fix + Trade-Republic-style P/L graphs + buy/sell markers.

FIXES
• Header reports the correct version after install. In a PyInstaller --onedir build the core/ source lives inside an archive, so Path(__file__).parent.parent did NOT resolve to the bundle's data folder. Now uses sys._MEIPASS when frozen, so version.json is found at <bundle>/_internal/version.json. The 'update available' banner will no longer fire when you're already on the latest.

P/L GRAPHS (Trade Republic style)
• The equity-curve charts (per-bot 1D/1W/1M and the overview total-portfolio chart) now plot Alpaca's deposit-adjusted profit_loss series instead of raw equity. So linking a new Alpaca account or transferring cash no longer fakes a vertical jump on the line — the baseline shifts silently, only the P/L moves.
• A dotted 'even' line marks y=0 (your baseline).
• Hover shows BOTH the P/L and the absolute equity value so you can still see the actual portfolio worth.
• Title now reads 'Performance — 1W  +$1,234.56  (+1.2%)  ·  Equity $42,000' so both numbers are visible at a glance.
• Affects equity_curve + combined_history_chart (used by every bot tab + the overview tab + the total portfolio chart on the overview).

BUY/SELL VERTICAL MARKERS
• Each filled order from the bot now draws a thin vertical line on its equity chart:
  - 🟠 orange dotted line = position opened (BUY for LONG/DAY, SELL-short for SHORT)
  - 🟢 green dotted line  = closed at profit
  - 🔴 red dotted line    = closed at loss
• Cost basis is tracked per ticker using a running weighted average, so the win/loss classification is correct even with partial fills and pyramid entries.
• A small triangle marker at the bottom of the chart lets you hover to see the exact ticker + price.

Server-side: no changes — Alpaca's get_portfolio_history already returns the profit_loss field, we just weren't reading it before.
